svg.title: Three Base Seats, Two Explicit Scale Additions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-base-and-scaled-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Three Base Seats, Two Explicit Scale Additions; subtitle: Base and Conservative use 1 FT + 2 C; Scaled uses 2 FT + 3 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each numeric value represents one person. The first three seats form the Base-Case pod; the final two exist only in the Scaled scenario. External professional engagements are purchased services, not additional dedicated operating seats in the canonical team count.; caption: Conservative: $75,000 revenue x 26% = $19,500 owner profit. Base: $362,500 x 38.0% = $137,750. Scaled: $650,000 x 50% = $325,000. The $650,000 scenario requires five people, not the three-person pod.; stages: label: Founder and commercial owner; value: Base seat 1; one full-time operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own partner contracts, state-specific permission records, pricing, revenue recognition decisions, and the monthly contribution statement. Maintain separate SaaS and affiliate ledgers and approve acquisition budgets using settled cohorts rather than headline click conversion.; label: Integration and reliability contractor; value: Base seat 2; one engineering contractor; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own feed adapters, market normalization, stale-data controls, signed server-to-server attribution, and deployment recovery. Use GitHub Actions for tests and PostgreSQL for replay-safe event identifiers. Never place customer credentials or user funds inside the terminal's operating scope.; label: Acquisition and editorial contractor; value: Base seat 3; one distribution contractor; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own eligible-state content, offer freshness, commercial disclosures, campaign cohorts, and seasonal budget pacing. Reconcile failed CPA events with partner reason codes and maintain a correction queue for expired promotions and mismatched settlement terms.; label: Product and reliability employee; value: Scaled seat 4; add one full-time operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add this seat only in the five-person Scaled scenario. Own release quality, subscription retention, incident response, and feed service objectives while the existing engineering contractor handles integration depth. Rebuild the cost plan within the Scaled $325,000 operating-cost envelope.; label: Settlement and support contractor; value: Scaled seat 5; add one operations contractor; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add this seat only in the Scaled scenario. Own commission statement imports, carryover balances, support triage, responsible-gaming referral handling, and partner discrepancy tickets. Keep discretionary promotional access separate from accounting adjustment permissions.
